name: An Affair With My Boss
overview: Lena is a driven, ambitious executive fighting to maintain control of her family's company in the face of a brewing power struggle. Her world is turned upside down when she begins a secret affair with Finn, a new and much younger employee, while her best friend Rachael is having an affair with her husband, Mark, who is campaigning for a political seat.Complicating matters further, Liam, a ruthless rival,schemes to undermine Lena's leadership and seize control of the company. He manipulates Zoe, Lena’s secretary, to gather information and undermine Lena from within. As the web of deceit and betrayal deepens, alliances shift and loyalties are tested...
